summary: The forum gate is met for the discharge claim. SPCB's reports of 22 October 2024, 3 February 2026 and 16 July 2026 record effluent reaching Morvali Creek through a bypass line at Survey No. 214. That engages the Water Act 1974 and the EPA 1986 (parent of the EIA Notification 2006), both Schedule I enactments, so a substantial environmental question arises out of their implementation.
recommendation: Set the forum to the NGT for the discharge, closure, compensation and restitution claims, and plead the Water Act and the EPA as the enactments the question arises under.
